item.title: Clare SVP Records Busiest Year Since Economic Crash
item.description: The Clare branch of Saint Vincent De Paul says 2025 has been their busiest year since the economic crash. Across the country, the society has received over 250,000 requests for assistance throughout the year. Meanwhile, in Clare 1,500 families were supported by the charity last year. item.title: 16% Rise In Calls Attended By Clare Fire Crews
item.description: Clare County Fire and Rescue Service has attended over 16% more call-outs this year than in 2024.
